SaveApplying: The mapping is being applied to the library in the background.
GenresHelp: The target genres are the genres to keep, they are never changed. In the Mapping tab, every other genre is replaced by a target genre or removed. By default every genre is a target genre, so nothing changes.
SuggestionsHelp: Genres that look like duplicates or translations of each other. Merging a genre replaces it with the suggested one everywhere.
Name: Name
RemoveConfirm: Remove the genre "{genre}" from {count} items? To replace it with another genre instead, merge it.
MappingHelp: The genre of each item is kept, replaced by a target genre or removed. Genres appearing later (new imports) are kept until they are mapped. Items with locked genres are never changed.
PreviewHelp: The changes the mapping, including the unsaved changes, would make to the items.
CommitHashHelp: Optional, for testing. Loads the web files of the plugin (settings page and translations) from this commit of the GitHub repository instead of the ones bundled with the plugin. Leave empty in normal use.
ResetHelp: Restores the original genres (the ones given by the metadata providers) of the items changed by the plugin, without changing any other metadata, and resets the mapping so every genre is kept. The genres changed since by something else are left as they are.
ResetConfirm: Restore the original genres of the items and reset the mapping?
ResetStarted: The original genres are being restored in the background.
